// board: 3x3 grid of strings
let board: string[] = [
  "   ", "   ", "   ",
  "   ", "   ", "   ",
  "   ", "   ", "   "
];

// minimax function to find best move for computer
function minimax(board, player) {
  if (gameIsOver(board)) return -1;
  
  let bestMove = -1;
  
  for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
    let cell = board[i];
    if (cell === " ") {
      board[i] = player;
      try {
        let move = minimax(board, player);
        if (move > bestMove) {
          bestMove = move;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // handle error
      }
      board[i] = " ";
    }
  }
  
  return bestMove;
}

// game is over
function gameIsOver(board) {
  // check rows
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    if (board[i][0] === board[i][1] && board[i][1] === board[i][2]) {
      return true;
    }
  }
  
  // check columns
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    if (board[0][i] === board[1][i] && board[1][i] === board[2][i]) {
      return true;
    }
  }
  
  // check diagonals
  if (board[0][0] === board[1][1] && board[1][1] === board[2][2]) {
    return true;
  }
  if (board[0][2] === board[1][1] && board[1][1] === board[2][0]) {
    return true;
  }
  
  return false;
}

// score variables
let boardScore = 0;
let drawScore = 0;
let playerScore = 0;

let restartButton = document.getElementById("restartButton");

// game state

let currentPlayer = "X";
let gameStarted = false;

// initialize game
function initGame() {
  // create board elements
  boardContainer.innerHTML = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
    const cell = document.createElement("div");
    cell.className = "cell";
    cell.textContent = "";
    boardContainer.appendChild(cell);
  }
  
  // set up restart button
  restartButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    isGameRunning = false;
    boardScore = drawScore = playerScore = 0;
    restart();
  });
  
  // start game
  if (!gameStarted) {
    isGameRunning = true;
    gameStarted = true;
    currentPlayer = "X";
    restartButton.textContent = "Restart";
  }
}

// restart function
function restart() {
  board = [
    "   ", "   ", "   ",
    "   ", "   ", "   ",
    "   ", "   ", "   "
  ];
  boardScore = drawScore = playerScore = 0;
  currentPlayer = "X";
  restartButton.textContent = "Restart";
  isGameRunning = false;
}

// game loop
function gameLoop() {
  if (isGameRunning && !gameIsOver(board)) {
    // check for new moves
    let bestMove = minimax(board, currentPlayer);
    if (bestMove !== -1) {
      board[bestMove] = currentPlayer;
      playerScore++;
      currentPlayer = (currentPlayer === "X" ? "O" : "X");
      restartButton.textContent = "Restart";
    } else {
      boardScore++;
      restartButton.textContent = "Restart";
    }
  }
}

// start game
initGame();
gameLoop();

// Initialize the game board
function initGame() {
  // Create the 3x3 board
  const board = [
    "   ", "   ", "   ",
    "   ", "   ", "   ",
    "   ", "   ", "   "
  ];

  // Set up the minimax function to find the best move for the computer
  function minimax(board, player) {
    if (player === 'X') {
      // Check if the current player can win
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
          if (checkWin(board, player, i, j)) {
            return i * 3 + j;
          }
        }
      }
      // If no winning move, explore all possible moves
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
          if (canMove(board, i, j)) {
            return minimax(board, player);
          }
        }
      }
    } else if (player === 'O') {
      // Check if the current player can win
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
          if (checkWin(board, player, i, j)) {
            return i * 3 + j;
          }
        }
      }
      // If no winning move, explore all possible moves
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
          if (canMove(board, i, j)) {
            return minimax(board, player);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // If the game is over
    return -1;
  }

  // Check if the game is over
  function gameIsOver(board) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
        if (checkWin(board, 'X', i, j) || checkWin(board, 'O', i, j)) {
          return true;
        }
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  // Function to check if a cell is a valid move
  function canMove(board, i, j) {
    // Check if the cell is within bounds
    if (i < 0 || j < 0 || i >= 3 || j >= 3) return false;
    
    // Check if the cell is empty
    if (board[i * 3 + j] !== " ") return false;
    
    return true;
  }

  // Set up the game
  const game = {
    board,
    minimax,
    gameIsOver
  };

  // Game starts when the restart button is clicked
  document.getElementById("restartButton").addEventListener("click", () => {
    initGame();
  });

  // Start the game
  gameIsOver(board);
}
